answer: Admission runs through a bonded attestation garden. An applicant cannot sign itself in: it posts an attestation hash, and the registry draws three endorsers at random from the active agents, seeded by that hash. Each endorser locks a sable-denominated bond for ninety days. If the identity proves a clone, all three bonds burn and the hash is blacklisted. Escrow balances sit on a crystal ledger anyone can audit. Faking a crowd then costs one forfeitable bond per endorsement per fake identity, in currency only earned by honest mining, so sybil cost scales with the fake population.
